body.title: Delegate the four gates readers to the shared decoder
body.summary: Make readDefineArtifact, readHldArtifact, readLldArtifact and readPlanArtifact in src/workflow/gates.ts call decodeArtifactHead, staying synchronous with unchanged return shapes and missing-file errors.
acceptanceChecks: each reader returns the same artifact and the same ArtifactMissingError as before for a head with no envelope parts
no caller of the four readers changed or became asynchronous
the gates, orchestrator and build-step tests pass unchanged

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/gates-delegation.test.ts: the four gates readers return the same artifact and the same missing-file error as before, synchronously
